notes: v3.0.76 - The version the practice validated live. On top of the repeat-pull fixes: closing your athenaOne tab can no longer silently block every pull until the browser restarts (the extension now notices the tab is gone and finds your new one), a briefly-offline extension worker retries your read instead of failing it, and the session keep-alive now keeps a minute-by-minute ledger so sign-out causes can be diagnosed instead of guessed. Everything from earlier releases remains: one-click pull of whoever is open, honest identity checks, full-speed background reads, and phone-confirmed note writes that stay notes-and-drafts only, confirmed by you. Requires Chrome 116+.
